name: Half-vector formulation for refracted path finding
definition: A method to find points P on a boundary that refract light from a source L to a scatter point V, using a half-vector H to handle shading normals where the geometric normal Ng differs from the shading normal Ns.
summary: This method validates refraction points by using a refractive half-vector to enforce Snell's law relative to shading normals, handling cases where shading normals differ from geometric normals.
